messages.subject: free but constrained factor loading?
parts:
Hello, 

How could I specify a forced free but constrained factor loading?

factor1 =~ v1*NA*var1_01 + v2*var2_01 + v3*var3_01
factor2 =~ v1*NA*var1_02 + v2*var2_02 + v3*var3_02

factor1 ~~ 1*factor1
factor2 ~~ 1*factor2

Using this I get the first loading free and the second equal to one.

Best,

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: free but constrained factor loading?
parts:
On 04/21/2013 11:14 PM, sebasti...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello,
>
> How could I specify a forced free but constrained factor loading?
>
> factor1 =~ v1*NA*var1_01 + v2*var2_01 + v3*var3_01
> factor2 =~ v1*NA*var1_02 + v2*var2_02 + v3*var3_02

You can only have one modifier (using the '*' operator) per term on the
left hand side, BUT you can repeat the same term multiple times:

factor1 =~ NA*var1_01 + v2*var2_01 + v3*var3_01 + v1*var1_01
factor1 =~ NA*var1_02 + v2*var2_02 + v3*var3_02 + v1*var1_02

Yves.
